conflicts.permit: We allow third parties, including business partners, advertising networks, and other advertising service providers, to collect information about your online activities through cookies, pixels, local storage, and other technologies to provide you interest based advertising.
conflicts.prohibit: These third party vendors and service providers only collect information about your use of our Platform in order to support us in providing you the Services.
conflicts.situation: Third-party vendors collecting user activity data on the platform to serve interest-based advertisements.
conflicts.reason: One sentence restricts third-party data collection strictly to supporting Amwell in providing Services, while the other permits third parties to collect data for interest-based advertising.
